vrtti:
kuśabdasya tatpuruṣe puruṣaśabde ca pare vibhāṣayā kādeśo bhavati, kāpuruṣaḥ, kupuruṣaḥ, iyam aprāpte vibhāṣaiva.
īṣaduṣṇam, koṣṇaṃ kavoṣṇaḥ kaduṣṇam iti vaktavyam.
notes:
ku一词在依主释中，当后面是puruṣa一词时，可以用kā代替，例如kāpuruṣaḥ, kupuruṣaḥ可怜人PS.6.3.106。这是一个有条件的两可aprāptavibhāsā\footnoteaprāptavibhāsā. f. the optional permission of an operation which without such permission would not take place at allPS.1.3.43。。
...%īṣaduṣṇam有点热, 可以说成是koṣṇaṃ kavoṣṇaḥ kaduṣṇam。
